purpose: Answer reviewer 1 comment 2 with evidence: does replacing the zero-tail prediction convention with hold-last materially change the deterministic solution, the closed-loop behaviour, or the optimizer/SGO conclusions?

conventions.zero_tail: u_j = 0 for j >= Nc; Gamma[i,j]=A^{i-j}B for j<min(i+1,Nc). This is the submitted and revised implementation (mpc_utils.build_prediction_matrices).
conventions.hold_last: u_j = u_{Nc-1} for j >= Nc; last column block becomes sum_{p=0}^{i-(Nc-1)} A^p B.
conventions.note_Nc1: At Nc=1 (the primary configuration) hold-last applies u_0 over the whole prediction horizon, so Gamma[i,0]=sum_{p=0}^{i}A^p B instead of A^i B. Substantially different prediction model, not a marginal correction.
conventions.distinct_from_warm_start: The tail convention governs the prediction model inside one optimisation; shift-and-hold warm starting constructs the initial guess for the next optimisation. Independent choices; only the first varies.

decision_vector_semantics: U=[u_0..u_{Nc-1}] absolute physical inputs, box bounded; verified by code inspection, not assumed.
mpc_configuration: frozen Phase-2A fixed-MPC primary (P from system_defs, Nc=1, Q_scale=1)
reference_solver: OSQP primary, multistart L-BFGS-B cross-check; convexity verified not assumed
pendcart_penalty: exact box-extrema certificate recomputed under hold-last; if the penalty can activate, that instance is not a pure QP and OSQP is not used for it
metric_families: finite-horizon optimization accuracy (gap vs the SAME convention's reference)
never: compare a hold-last stochastic solution against a zero-tail optimum; treat lower nRMSE as evidence of better finite-horizon optimization

material_change_criteria.negligible: mean first-input change < 1e-6 of input range AND relative nRMSE change < 0.1% AND no ordering change in either metric family
material_change_criteria.small: mean first-input change < 1% of input range AND relative nRMSE change < 1% AND no ordering change in either metric family
material_change_criteria.material: anything else, in particular ANY ordering change in either metric family or relative nRMSE change >= 1%

stop_conditions: standalone zero-tail does not reproduce production
hold-last loses convexity and the reference cannot be certified
tail convention materially changes an established conclusion
